pc: PC is a small digital computer based on a microprocessor and designed to be used by one person at a time.
PC means the same as personal computer or microcomputer.
pc board: PC board is a removable circuit board for a personal computer.
pcp: PCP is a person who helps in identifying or preventing or treating illness or disability.
PCP can also mean a drug used as an anesthetic by veterinarians.
PCP means the same as health professional or primary care provider or health care provider.
pct: A pct is a proportion in relation to a whole.
Pct means the same as percentage or percent or per centum.
